rules.title: Investigation disposition must produce a reviewed outcome
rules.expected_behavior: A decision module should return a concrete reviewed outcome or an explicit abstention reason for each labelled case.
expected_outcomes: label matches the reviewed case expectation
abstention is correct when evidence is insufficient
negative_outcomes: unexplained undecided output is not accepted as a correct decision

rules.title: DLP analysis status must match completed analysis
rules.expected_behavior: When a DLP analysis run completes, the visible alert status and assessment record should advance consistently.
expected_outcomes: completed model run is reflected in the alert status
negative_outcomes: alert remains running after model run completion

rules.title: Role boundaries must match declared access policy
rules.expected_behavior: Each protected API and workflow should allow only the roles declared by the owner-reviewed policy.
expected_outcomes: allowed roles can reach intended pages
denied roles receive explicit denial or redirect
